title: board.setup_flows: a module's guided setup, rendered by the board at #/setup/<module> (one flow per module). Compile adds `module`, `fields` (each secret's label, pattern and help, from its `setup:`) and, with a pair_url, `pair_token` (the name of the generated secret <module>_pair_token the board sends as bearer) and a network between the board and that service.

order.description: where it sits among the flows, lowest first

why.description: one sentence: what the person gets

effort.description: e.g. about 2 minutes, needs the Telegram app

steps.description: markdown; {board_url} becomes the board's own address (where its sign-ins return), and inline code gets a copy button

secrets.description: names of this module's secrets with `setup:`, shown as paste fields in this order

signin.description: an id from this module's board.signins: its connect button

pair_url.description: the pairing endpoint of one of this module's services

connect_url.description: a connect path the board already serves for a connection that is not a board.signins entry: its Connect button; done once that connection is signed in

needs_name.description: why this setup needs a named address: shown instead of the steps and fields when the board's address is a bare IP (loopback excepted)
